question: Who among the following was considered the first notable king of the Pushyabhuti dynasty, ruling from 580-605 CE?
solution:
The correct answer is option 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prabhakaravardhana was the first notable king of the Pushyabhuti dynasty and ruled between 580-605 CE.
 
• He is remembered for consolidating the dynasty's power and expanding its territorial influence in northern India.
 
• Prabhakaravardhana was the father of Harsha Vardhana, who later became one of the most celebrated rulers of ancient India.
 
• Under Prabhakaravardhana's reign, the Pushyabhuti dynasty established its capital at Thanesar (modern-day Haryana).
 
• Prabhakaravardhana strengthened the military and administration of the dynasty, laying the foundation for its future prominence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pushyabhuti Dynasty:**

 
 
• The Pushyabhuti dynasty was an ancient Indian dynasty that ruled in northern India during the early medieval period.
 
• Its capital was located at Thanesar, a prominent city in modern-day Haryana.
 
• The dynasty gained prominence under Prabhakaravardhana and reached its zenith under Harsha Vardhana.
 
 
 
• **Harsha Vardhana:**
 
 
• Harsha Vardhana, son of Prabhakaravardhana, succeeded him and ruled from 606-647 CE.
 
• Harsha expanded the empire significantly and is known for his patronage of arts and Buddhism.
 
• He authored notable works like ""Nagananda,"" a Sanskrit drama.
 
 
 
• **Thanesar:**
 
 
• Thanesar was a historic city and the capital of the Pushyabhuti dynasty.
 
• It was an important center of politics and religion in ancient India.
 
• Thanesar is associated with various historical and archaeological sites today.
 
 
 
• **Administration under Prabhakaravardhana:**
 
 
• Prabhakaravardhana focused on strengthening the military and administrative systems of the dynasty.
 
• He laid the groundwork for the expansion of the dynasty under his successors.
